::: {.notes}
~1 minute. Walk the arc, not every session: we start with AI for literature review and evidence aggregation, then turn to communicating research, with hands-on sessions on dynamic presentations and on drafting and getting feedback on working papers. After lunch, participants build a reproducibility package for their own project, and the Data Group presents AI tools for data documentation and publication. The slide groups sessions by theme: in the schedule, the adoption-plan session (3:15) comes before the data documentation session (4:00). The adoption plan sets 6-week and 3-month targets that we will follow up on in a survey. Agenda source: the Day 3 schedule on the bootcamp website (_data/bootcamp.yml).
:::
